recipes.label: Sun Shrine Hint
recipes.startdescription:
You need 1 'A Splendour' — the highest‑level Lantern Influence — to restore damaged Reason here.

You can combine same‑level Influences to upgrade them at the Sun Shrine, or use a 'Revelation' to upgrade any Lantern Influence regardless of level.

Starting the action without playing any card will randomly grant a 6th-order Influence, but doing so carries a small chance of drawing a Malice. You may also spend Reason at a Sun Shrine to reliably gain 1 6th-order Lantern Influence.

recipes.label: Foundry Hint
recipes.startdescription:
You need 12 Forge and a 'Strength' to restore damaged Health here, but you may only do so once at each Foundry.

You may also craft useful consumables here. Pressing 'Start' will give you a list of recipes for craftable items.
